title: Reduced affine flat preparation
statement: Let $X$ be an affine scheme and $f:X\to T$ a locally finite type morphism [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $V\subset T$ be an affine open containing the image of $f$, and let $\eta\in V$ be a generic point of $T$. There are an affine open $U\subset T$ containing $\eta$, integral affine $S$ [def-pc-integral-scheme], reduced affine $Z$ [def-pc-reduced-scheme], and universal homeomorphisms $q:S\to U$ and $h:Z\to X\times_T S$ [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism, def-pc-fibre-product], where $S\to T$ is $q$ followed by the inclusion of $U$. The composite $g=h\circ\operatorname{pr}_S$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally finitely presented [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. There is a generic point $\eta_0$ of $S$ mapping to $\eta$.

proof.text: Factor f through V and take the reductions of the affine source and base. The reduced source factors through the reduced base by killing nilpotents in coordinate rings. The reduced base is integral since its space has a generic point. The reductions and the induced map into the original pullback are surjective closed immersions; on rings the latter is the quotient from B/((nilradical A)B) to B/nilradical B.

The reduced affine morphism is locally finite type and quasi-compact. Apply generic flat finite presentation to it. Choose a principal open about the generic point in the nonempty flat finitely presented locus; lift its coordinate element from the reduced ring to the original ring of V. This defines U. Restrict the reduced base and source to the corresponding principal opens. They stay affine and reduced, and flatness and local finite presentation restrict.
The restricted reduction maps give q and h. Lift the generic point along the homeomorphism q, and use preservation of closure under a homeomorphism to verify it is generic.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_reduced_flat_affine_preparation
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] (f : X ⟶ T) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (V : T.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (himage : Set.range f ⊆ V)
    (η : T) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ) (hηV : η ∈ V) :
    ∃ (U : T.Opens), η ∈ U ∧ IsAffineOpen U ∧
      ∃ (S Z : Scheme.{u}) (q : S ⟶ U.toScheme)
        (h : Z ⟶ pullback f (q ≫ U.ι)),
        IsAffine S ∧ IsIntegral S ∧ IsAffine Z ∧ IsReduced Z ∧
        IsUniversalHomeomorphism q ∧ IsUniversalHomeomorphism h ∧
        Flat (h ≫ pullback.snd f (q ≫ U.ι)) ∧
        LocallyOfFinitePresentation (h ≫ pullback.snd f (q ≫ U.ι)) ∧
        ∃ η' : S, IsGenericPoint η' Set.univ ∧ (q ≫ U.ι) η' = η

proof_origin.note: Detailed steps follow Tag 0559: reduce source and base, shrink by generic flat finite presentation, and lift the principal open through the reduction quotient.
